verdict.rationale: Evidence only indirectly supports this: a community comment notes Angular 2 needs no 'bridges' to use 3rd-party JS libraries, and Angular Elements is mentioned as a feature, but there is no first-party documentation describing ElementRef/Renderer2/ViewChild APIs or a concrete example of integrating a charting library. missing for 10: official docs on ElementRef/Renderer2 for native DOM access, a hands-on example (e.g., D3/Chart.js integration), independent corroboration beyond a single forum comment.
